notes.scope: EVERY key in this file is read by code. Keys that no code read were deleted rather than left in place: an inert tunable is worse than no tunable, because editing it looks like it does something. Before adding a key here, add the reader first.

readers.version: cc_memory/cli/mem.py:_resolve_version and cc_memory/mcp/server.py:_resolve_version, both as the LAST-RESORT fallback for a flat standalone install that predates core/version.py. core/version.py __version__ is canonical; this literal must agree with it, and tests/smoke_test.py asserts that. Citations here name SYMBOLS, not line numbers: line numbers rot on every refactor - `grep -n "def <symbol>" <file>` is authoritative.
readers.consolidation.auto_interval_sessions: cc_memory/hooks/consolidate_async.py:_auto_interval; non-positive or unparseable falls back to 5.
readers.ccl.enabled / ccl.ollama_url / ccl.local: cc_memory/llm/ccl_backend.py:_load_local_config. The local Ollama fallback is OPT-IN: enabled=false means the Anthropic legs (env key -> Claude Code OAuth token, each with its own wire format) are the only backends.
readers.excluded_projects: cc_memory/core/modes.py:is_excluded - ONE implementation, called as the first act of ALL SIX hooks (user_prompt, pre_compact, post_tool_use, stop, session_start, consolidate_async) AND of cc_memory/mcp/server.py:_get_db, the single choke point every MCP tool reaches. The MCP server is the seventh caller and was missing through v2.5.1: it is loaded by default from the shipped manifest and every call is model-initiated. cc_memory/core/modes.py:read_config is THE runtime reader of this file (utf-8-sig, fails closed on an unusable config); cli/mem.py and mcp/server.py keep their own version-only readers.

notes.excluded_projects_usage: Absolute paths of projects that opt OUT of cc-memory entirely. A listed directory, and anything beneath it, gets no memory/ directory, no memory.db, no observations, no extraction, no PROGRESS.md and no context injection - every one of the six hooks exits 0 immediately, and every MCP tool answers isError. This holds whether or not the project was already initialised: through v2.5.0 the check lived in only two hooks, so a project added to this list AFTER it had a memory.db kept being captured (and, with a credential present, kept being sent to the Anthropic API); through v2.5.1 the MCP server had no check at all. Matching is on the RESOLVED absolute path and is case-insensitive on Windows, case-sensitive elsewhere. A drive/filesystem root ('C:\\', '/') excludes everything beneath it - through v2.5.1 it matched nothing. Relative entries and ~ are expanded; a ~user that cannot be expanded is compared literally instead of aborting the whole list. Example: ["D:\\Private\\client-work", "/home/me/secret-project"]. This is the only opt-out; there is no per-project override file. FAILS CLOSED since v2.5.2: if this file exists and cannot be used (invalid JSON, not a JSON object, not UTF-8 text, unreadable), EVERY project is treated as excluded and the reason is logged - the plugin goes quiet rather than guessing 'not excluded' and storing data irreversibly. An ABSENT or EMPTY config is NOT that case. The file is read as utf-8-sig, so a BOM (PowerShell's Out-File default) is fine. NOTE: the standalone installer preserves this list across a reinstall (ui/installer.py), but a marketplace/dev checkout keeps config.json under git, so `git pull` can revert your edit - and a merge conflict left in the file will now suspend the plugin until you resolve it.
notes.removed_keys: extraction.*, writer.*, injection.*, observation.*, idle_reorg.*, archive.*, modes.default, web_viewer.port, mcp.auto_register and logging.* were declared here and read by NO code - two independent audits measured 34 of 51 leaf keys with no Python reader. The live values are module constants; change them there, not here (symbols, not line numbers): writer thresholds llm/memory_writer.py HIGH_SIM/MID_SIM/MIN_CONTENT_LEN/MAX_CANDIDATES_TO_SCAN, injection budgets hooks/session_start.py _DEFAULT_BUDGET/_LAYER_BUDGETS, idle reorg interval core/idle.py IDLE_INTERVAL_TURNS, observation skip-list core/modes.py MODES (per mode), web viewer port the --port default in ui/web_viewer.py:main. mcp.auto_register never had an implementation - MCP registration is the mcpServers block in .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
